Lesser Armor 673 (Effect[0] aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE) is set on the dummy with its effect 0 amount changed to 5000 in both arms (a fixture size, not a claimed value) so the dummy armor reads 5528 (528 pinned reference armor plus 5000), as the Sun Cleric Vindicator 707773 ignores_armor entry.
